scope.population: 2480267 taker fills re-marked at every rung of the 8-point horizon grid; persistence over wallet-coin units with at least 10 fills in each half (the loosest rung of settings.RANK_FLOOR_SENSITIVITY), with [25, 50] as robustness and a separate per-coin table at a 50-fill floor
scope.window: days 4-13 of the December window, split by settings.split_early_late into early [4, 5, 6, 7, 8] and late [9, 10, 11, 12, 13]

declared_not_confirmed.note: settings.py declares these; this run did not state what it used, so they are the declaration and not a property of this artifact

settings_fingerprint.early_late_split: settings.split_early_late over the days present: early [4, 5, 6, 7, 8], late [9, 10, 11, 12, 13]
settings_fingerprint.overrides_note: this file re-marks a GRID and selects no window; horizon_s is recorded only because the reproduction gate is asserted there. rank_floor_fills 10 primary with 25 and 50 as robustness: ten is the LOOSEST rung of settings.RANK_FLOOR_SENSITIVITY and not the declared 50, and it is load-bearing here because the horizon was chosen on this curve. master_seed is settings.MASTER_SEED and is stated as a CONFIRMATION rather than a deviation: this file used to declare 424242 for the permutation and 20260619 for the bootstrap, and now derives both streams from the declared seed and the cell identity through settings.rng, so each of the 56 cells draws its own stream instead of all of them re-drawing one. reliability_seed does not apply: the split-half reliability here is an ODD/EVEN split by fill order, which is deterministic and draws no random numbers, unlike the seeded estimator settings.RELIABILITY_SEED belongs to -- so the two reliabilities are NOT the same estimator and must not be compared cell for cell. n_perm is settings.N_PERM and is stated here as a CONFIRMATION rather than a deviation: the run used the declared budget, so the floor is 1/(N_PERM+1) and not the 0.00498 the earlier 200-draw artifact reported. n_boot is settings.N_BOOT and is a CONFIRMATION as well, adopted 2026-07-31 against the 500 the earlier artifact drew, so fifty draws decide each endpoint instead of twelve and a half; in this file the same draws also set boot_se, which is the width of the parsimony tie-break in the selection block, so the budget reaches a discrete list here and not only a band. The halves are cut by settings.split_early_late over the days present, which on this input returns the same 4-8 / 9-13 the file used to type

final_decision.recommended_source: settings.HEADLINE_HORIZON_S, read back so this file and the declaration cannot drift; the evidence for it is the curve and the two checks below
final_decision.rationale: persistence falls monotonically with h; the permanent impact is ~fully impounded by 5-10s (1s captures only ~80% of the plateau); 10s is the shortest conventional horizon at the plateau, keeps high persistence (0.52 disatt vs 0.32 at 60s), and equals the maker reaction window; 60s is dominated for SCORING (half the persistence, no extra info) and is kept only as the reported companion; 1s rejected (info incomplete + transient/own-impact contamination). The most persistent info-complete rung is 5s, which no producer writes a column for, which is why it is not adopted.
